The '''New Venture Terrace''' was an open-air terrace located in the [[Office Atrium]] of the [[Ternion Building]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]],<ref name="TOR:UOA" /> above the [[New Venture Plaza]].<ref name="TOR:LOA">{{TORcite|type=location|Lower Office Atrium|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> After their [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Eternal Empire]] built a [[Nar Shaddaa shield bunker|shield bunker]] in the Ternion Building overlooking the plaza, with the only entrance located on the terrace.<ref name="TOR:NSTSB" />
